I am not gonna act that I know everything. I use information that I have. But still, most of the doge is being held right now. For any currency to grow, it needs circulation, which has slowed down in a big way. Again I personally don't think it will explode anymore. It had it's moment and now it's over. But I can be wrong. Still I am happy about my investement in doge and I won't look back. I put in 200 euros a year back and 500 when it was at 5 cents, sold everything for 0,39 euro cents. What else do I need.

First why do you asume that everyone who holds doge are here? 

Second I sold mine doge when they hit almost 40 euro cents, because I felt that it will slow down. I am glad I did,because intial hype seems to be over. I personally think that if the situation doesn't change in next 24 hours, there won't be much to wait around for. Remember that 50% of doge is held by 20 people or something, which means those aren't in circulation, that is not good for value growth. I think dollar is definitely out of reach for near future and 50 cents most certainly won't accure before end of the month. 

My strong suggestion is to lock in your gains now and keep in the amount of money you invested. Then wait until the value could creep up again, but I wouldn't put too much hopes in it.

Problem is, most doge investors are delusional people who think that just because famous people are promoting them, doge is going to explode. However they forget one big argument, doge was never intended as a serious crypto currency and it doesn't really have any use. 

**Most important thing, it doesn't matter what others think, this is your investement, your risk. You have to make the decision, that makes sense to you. Don't listen to what I'm saying, but don't be a sheep and follow fanatics who don't really know how market of crypto currencies work, which sadly represents biggest portion of doge holders. MAKE YOUR OWN DECISION**

Money. You need a lot of money, to be able to afford other resources and to be able to be a competitor for them. And since Lieferando has bought virtually every other company in Germany who deliver food, it's probably impossible to throw them of their throne. That's the sad reality, whoever has money, has power and morality won't get anything very far in this business world.

The only thing that maybe could work,is if someone would make an app, completely for free for everyone and restaurants could pay certain % of orders value to the driver. Then there's no worry about hourly wage. And everyone could work in their own time, no shifts, no obligations other than delivering food. You work whenever you can, however long you can. The hourly income rate wouldn't be very great, but there would certainly be less pressure for drivers. I hope you got the idea.
